summary: Create an external-postgres-configuration Secret (host, port 5432, database, username, password without quotes or backslashes, sslmode prefer/disable/allow/require/verify-ca/verify-full, type unmanaged) and set spec.controller.postgres_configuration_secret; without controller.name a new <aap>-controller instance is created.
questions: How do I configure an external database for automation controller on OpenShift?
What sslmode values does the controller database secret accept?
Use an external database for an existing controller instance

answer_card.title: External database for controller
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: external-postgres-configuration
  namespace: <target_namespace>
stringData:
  host: "<db_host>"
  port: "5432"
  database: "<db_name>"
  username: "<user>"
  password: "<password>"
  sslmode: "prefer"   # disable, allow, require, verify-ca, verify-full
  type: "unmanaged"
type: Opaque
```
```yaml
spec:
  controller:
    name: controller-dev   # optional, existing instance
    postgres_configuration_secret: external-postgres-configuration
```
